subject: [PATCH v1 1/2] mm/swap: refault on swap-in, not in the swap cache allocator

2026-08-17.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where the workingset_refault function is called on every allocation in the swap cache allocator, even when it's not a refault event. The function is moved out of __swap_cache_alloc and into the callers that perform actual swap-in operations. This change ensures that refaulting is only triggered for true swap-in events, preventing incorrect counting of anon refault/activation. Additionally, the patch updates the folio_activate function to handle already-LRU folios correctly.
